mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflexes was most worthwhile: the head-turn example brought the separate sensors and pathways together in a recognizable action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the two sets of organs was straightforward but added little explanation beyond grouping them together.

surprise.text: The weighted membranes respond both to gravity and changes in straight-line motion; the comparison between tilting and moving forward helped explain that.

arbitrary.text: The required order for adding reflex connections was not clear to me: I expected to connect them to the organs with nerves, but had to attach those organs to the body first.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter if it similarly connected a familiar experience to a mechanism. The final head-turn example made the assembly meaningful, though some intermediate combinations felt predictable.
